decisions: Duplicate removal requires confirmation and only removes the local index entry.
Backup import is merge-only; archive files, SAF grants, and derived cover images are excluded.

Use Junrar only for RAR decompression; the app does not create RAR-compatible archives. Initial support is single-volume and unencrypted, with explicit warnings for other variants. Reopen and rescan SAF streams to read requested pages without temporary files.
Long-strip reading continues to use the existing vertical scroll preference and memory-only page data.
